parameters.title: User Decision
parameters.message: Please choose how to proceed with this capture:

parameters.description: Apply template annotations to an image file and save with suffix

arguments.name: file
arguments.description: Path to the input image to annotate

name: CLI Apply Template & Annotation
description: Loads an image file, applies a template watermark/badge annotation, and saves the result under the same name with a suffix (e.g. example1.png -> example1-with_annotation.png).

parameters.description: Convert an image from one format to another

arguments.name: file
arguments.description: Path to the input image file to convert

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Target image format (png, jpg, webp, bmp, gif, tiff)

name: CLI Image Format Converter
description: Loads an image file, converts it to the requested target format (png, jpg, webp, bmp, gif, tiff), and saves it under the same name with the new extension.

parameters.description: Extract text from an image file using OCR and return to stdout

arguments.name: file
arguments.description: Path to the image file to extract text from

arguments.name: lang
arguments.description: Optional OCR language code (e.g. eng, deu, fra)

name: CLI Headless OCR Text Extractor
description: Loads a bitmap file from the command line, extracts all visible text via OCR, and outputs the plain text directly to the console stdout.

parameters.description: Scan and decode QR codes from an image file

arguments.name: file
arguments.description: Path to the bitmap image containing the QR code

name: CLI QR Code & Barcode Extractor
description: Reads a bitmap file from the command line, decodes any QR codes or barcodes on the image, and outputs the decoded text directly to stdout.

name: Clipboard Format Converter & Watermark
description: Automatically detects external image clipboard copies (e.g. DeviceIndependentBitmap, DIBV5, or PNG), applies a subtle timestamped watermark annotation, and re-places clean PNG data onto the clipboard.

name: DAG Workflow with environment watermark and parallel feedback
description: Demonstrates DAG branching, variable assignment, scoped user/machine environment variables, mathematical positioning expressions, and multi-drawable surface stamping.

nodes.name: Join Paths and Export to Editor

name: Editor Template: Confidential Watermark
description: Exposed directly inside the Greenshot Editor 'Recipes' menu. When selected, applies a red 'CONFIDENTIAL' banner and watermark directly to the active editor surface in-place without exporting.

name: Region Snip with External Tool Optimization
description: Interactive region snip that runs an external command to optimize the image and reloads it into the editor.

name: QR Codes Showcase (Payments, Business Cards & Links)
description: Demonstrates inserting multiple structured QR codes: an EPC SEPA bank transfer QR code for payments, a vCard contact business card, and a dynamic website link with rounded dots styling.

name: Region with Blue Border
description: Interactive region capture that adds a 2px blue border and opens the editor

triggers.name: Target Window with DLP Redaction Hotkey

name: Target Window with DLP Redaction
description: Captures a specific targeted window, adds a drop shadow effect, runs OCR to find sensitive tokens and emails by regex pattern, redacts them, and opens the editor

parameters.title: Capture window
parameters.description: Screenshot of one window, with its exact contents even when other windows cover it. The window is not activated. Use list_windows first and pass the id of the window (e.g. w7).

arguments.name: window
arguments.description: The id of the window from list_windows, e.g. w7

arguments.name: ocr
arguments.description: true to also return the text in the image (OCR) with the position of each line

name: AI tool: capture window
description: Captures a window for an AI tool, with its exact contents (also when it is covered), without activating it

parameters.title: Capture region
parameters.description: Screenshot of a part of the screen, in screen coordinates (list_windows has the bounds of the windows and displays). Use it to see details at full resolution.

arguments.name: ocr
arguments.description: true to also return the text in the image (OCR) with the position of each line

name: AI tool: capture region
description: Captures a part of the screen for an AI tool

parameters.title: Capture screen
parameters.description: Screenshot of all displays. For one display or a part of the screen use capture_region with the bounds from list_windows.

arguments.name: ocr
arguments.description: true to also return the text in the image (OCR) with the position of each line

name: AI tool: capture screen
description: Captures all displays for an AI tool

name: Capture of a notification
description: Offer the capture of a clicked notification in the destination flyout
